fact: The World Bank's restructuring paper of 23 December 2025 states that the GALOP accountability dashboard is functional and links the mobile School Report Card (mSRC) and the EMIS, that 16,200 schools reported using its data at cluster-level meetings, that the EMIS and ICT units are being refurbished and given servers, and that the project, financed by an IDA credit and GPE grants, had its IDA credit closing date extended by 12 months; it describes no record per learner entered by schools.
title: Restructuring Paper on a Proposed Project Restructuring of Ghana Accountability for Learning Outcomes Project
